paygen: build full DLC payloads Steps this CL performs: 1) Searches available target DLC images in release bucket (example: gs://chromeos-releases/dev-channel/eve-arcnext/9999.0.0/dlc) 2) For each available target DLC images, generate full payload for it. Process on generating a DLC payload: 1) We run DLC payload generation step based on image attribute |dlc_id| (None if not a DLC image). For DLC payload generation: 2) we set partition name (only one) as 'dlc_'+dlc_id. 3) We set target partition (only one) as the image (and we skip partition extraction step). 4) We set source partitions to be empty since we only generate full payload currently and avoid unexpected delta payload to be generated. 5) We skip --new_postinstall_config_file for DLC full payload. More details are in the diffs.
